# Camp Resource: Toxic Gooler Cooler

Save yourself a trip to a secret lab and get the good stuff right at home!

Generates Toxic Goo.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Toxic Gooler Cooler__

**Produces**

Toxic Goo

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Glass

1x Nuclear Material

1x Steel

**Holds**

3 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Season 20 - Glow of the Ghoul - Page 5 - 60 Tickets

Gold Bullion - X - Cautious - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

30 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
